deadline.quote: To apply, you should use the online system (Deadline: December 10, 2026, a $90 application fee).

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for this cycle but may be submitted.
gre_general.quote: UChicago CS will not require the GRE exam for this PhD application cycle. It is optional.

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to this field.

supervisor.value: You may email faculty, but admission decisions are made by the department, not by individual supervisors.
supervisor.quote: while you are free to email faculty to explore possible common research interests, admission decisions are made by the Department.

also.quote: the student demonstrates knowledge in several fundamental subareas of Computer Science through courses, starts doing research, and refines their research interests, including identifying a research advisor.

funding.value: Physical Sciences Division PhD admits are offered funding packages covering full tuition, health insurance and a stipend.
funding.quote: Applicants admitted to doctoral programs in the Physical Sciences Division are offered generous funding packages. | Offers include full tuition, student health insurance and student services fee coverage, and primary funding

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: The Joint Math/CS PhD is a separate admission route.
